author: praasz
title: CPU functional tests fail with Not enough CPU resources on Windows runner
key_errors: Not enough CPU resources! (istreams_executor.cpp:187) in smoke_Model_Distribution_MatMul tests with MODEL_DISTRIBUTION_POLICY=TENSOR_PARALLEL
root_cause: 20 MatMulLayerTest tests with MODEL_DISTRIBUTION_POLICY=TENSOR_PARALLEL all fail because the Windows CI runner does not have sufficient CPU resources to satisfy the tensor parallel executor thread requirements. The error originates from istreams_executor.cpp:187, which throws when the requested thread count exceeds available CPU resources. The failing PR (#37073) only modifies Python async_infer_queue bindings and is unrelated to the CPU tensor parallel path. This is an infrastructure resource constraint on the Windows runner.
